title: Sheinbaum Calls on the Bank of Mexico to Review High Pensions of Its Former Officials
author: Emir Olivares and Alma E. Muñoz
content:
_This article by[Emir Olivares and Alma E.
Muñoz](https://www.jornada.com.mx/autores/Emir%20Olivares%20y%20Alma%20E.%20Mu%C3%B1oz)
originally appeared in the [October 6, 2026 edition of La
Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/10/06/politica/sheinbaum-
llama-al-bdem-a-revisar-altas-pensiones-de-sus-ex-funcionarios), Mexico's
premier left wing daily newspaper._

**Mexico City**. Amid the debate over the high pensions received by former
senior officials of the Bank of Mexico (BdeM), President Claudia Sheinbaum
Pardo **called on that institution to reconsider those payments**.

“It would be worthwhile for the Bank of Mexico to carry out a review,” she
said this morning at her press conference in the National Palace, since those
high payments are “immoral.”

She recalled that figures such as Guillermo Ortiz, who was governor of the
institution, and Ernesto Zedillo, who also held a senior post there and later
became President of the Republic, are two of the beneficiaries of those high
pensions, which are **above the income of the head of the federal Executive**.

“We made a reform for the golden pensions. Which, by the way, we have to
resolve a contradiction there is in the Constitution, which in one place says
‘limit of the President’ and in the other says ‘half the salary.’ That has to
be resolved.”

To that end, she said, the Legal Counsel of the federal Executive is already
working, preparing a response to those contradictions.

“For now it was resolved from the Legal Counsel in favor of the greater right,
there cannot be higher pensions in certain institutions, such as the Federal
Electricity Commission, the former Luz y Fuerza del Centro, Nafinsa, Banobras.
In the decentralized institutions of the government **those pensions cannot
exceed the President’s salary**.”

She noted that in the case of the Bank of Mexico “it was left out of this
reform.”

> That does not mean that what they are doing is not immoral. How can it be
> 400 thousand pesos (in pension)? And many of them worked only six years at
> the Bank of Mexico.
>
> President Claudia Sheinbaum
